name: No word boundary in the writing system
name_fr: La frontière de mot n'existe pas dans l'écriture

origin.campaign: August 2026 — observation campaign, verdicts on scripts and on rare genres (2026-08-08)

seen.corpus: observation 2026-08 — 19 documents in 8 non-Latin scripts (Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Thai, Cyrillic, Devanagari, Han, polytonic Greek), 17 platforms outside the mainstream (J-STAGE, ThaiJO, journals of Mali, Algeria, Argentina, Brazil, North Macedonia)
seen.excerpt: Japanese, Chinese, Thai: this is not « words that are harder to segment », the information was never written into the file. And the irreversible case, measured on 2026-08-08: a Western name transliterated into katakana, エルンストデイヴィットヘルプシュレブ = Ernst David Herbschleb — three words, sixteen characters, zero boundary. No treatment can restore the original name.
seen.reserve: observation cited from the August campaign; the documents of that wave were not kept by identifier, so this form has no reproducible example yet

prevention.note: a boundary that was never written cannot be recovered by a rule; a dictionary can guess, and a guess is not a boundary

repair.note: deletion cannot restore a boundary that was never there; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.note: 0 of 1,355 restored; 24 twins deleted and the 1,674 true facts they took were not restored
measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: One entity written as two is repaired by MERGING them. Deleting the twin removes the false node and does not give back the facts it took: measured, 24 twins deleted of 1,355 and 1,674 true facts not restored.
obstacle.reason_fr: Une entité écrite en deux se répare en les FUSIONNANT. Supprimer le jumeau retire le faux nœud et ne rend pas les faits qu'il avait emportés : mesuré, 24 jumeaux sur 1 355 et 1 674 faits vrais non rétablis.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.

history.event: created from the August 2026 verdicts on scripts and on rare genres, which the atlas had never carried

proposed_severity.reason: no word boundary in the writing system: segmentation manufactures false entities, which then receive facts
proposed_severity.status: proposed — a second reader confirms or contests, as for the 43 validated forms
proposed_severity.note: this reading agrees with how the August catalogue judges most SPLIT forms (G1), so it adds little
proposed_severity.reason_fr: aucune frontière de mot dans l'écriture : la segmentation fabrique de fausses entités, qui reçoivent ensuite des faits
